catalog.model.gemma4E2b.notes: Fastest option. Sees images and video frames, hears audio, thinks when asked.
catalog.model.gemma4E4b.notes: The recommended default: TensorSharp's verified fast-path tier, multimodal, with an optional speculative draft head.
catalog.model.gemma4Size12b.notes: The dense Gemma between E4B and the 26B mixture of experts, in the 2.7 bpw IQ2_M recipe. Its 4.2 GB weights file is memory-mapped when loaded. Runtime RAM also includes resident weights, the 32k conversation cache and processing buffers. Vision and a speculative draft head are optional downloads.
catalog.model.bonsai2Size27b.notes: PrismML's ternary Qwen 3.5 hybrid with Hadamard-rotated weights. The 5.9 GB download is repacked losslessly to about 7.7 GB when it loads, so it is offered only on 16 GB devices. Vision is an optional download.
catalog.model.qwen35Size9b.notes: Strong general model with vision; the projector is optional and costs ~1.8 GB of memory when loaded.
catalog.model.qwen38Size27b.notes: Qwen's dense 27B at four bits: stronger than the 9B at reasoning, coding and agent work, and slower, since all 27B parameters run for every token. Needs 32 GB of system memory (RAM). Vision is an optional download. An optional DFlash draft model is available. Its speedup depends on the backend and sampling settings.
catalog.model.museGlimmer30b.notes: A dense 30B that reads images and calls tools. It reasons in its own channel before answering, even with thinking off. Needs 32 GB of system memory (RAM). Vision is an optional download and takes about 8 GB more memory when loaded. An optional DFlash draft model is available. Its speedup depends on the backend and sampling settings.
catalog.model.qwen38FlashNext.notes: Qwen's 125B mixture of experts (6B active per token) in UD-Q2_K_XL mixed quantization. Needs 48 GB of system memory (RAM) and about 79 GB of SSD storage for three shards. Selected experts and the n-gram table are read from SSD on demand, so the first answers after loading can be slower while those pages warm up. Vision (images and video frames) and the shared MTP speculative draft head are optional downloads.
catalog.model.qwen38FlashNextIq1m.notes: Qwen's 125B mixture of experts (6B active per token) in UD-IQ1_M mixed quantization. Requires at least 32 GB of system memory (RAM) and about 75 GB of SSD storage for three shards. Experts and the n-gram table are read from SSD on demand, so the first answer can be slower. Images need an optional 0.9 GB projector download. Verified on Windows with CUDA, 32 GB RAM and 16 GB GPU memory. Vision (images and video frames) and the shared MTP speculative draft head are optional downloads.
catalog.model.qwenImage21.notes: Makes a picture from a description, or edits an attached photo. Needs 24 GB of system memory (RAM).
catalog.model.qwenImage21TurboAdQ4k.note: Qwen-Image 2.1 distilled to 8 steps instead of 40: makes a picture from a description, or edits an attached photo, in about a fifth of the time. It shares the text encoder, VAE and vision files with Qwen-Image 2.1, so they download once. Only the plug-ins validated on it apply, never a speed plug-in. Needs 24 GB of system memory (RAM).
catalog.model.qwenImage21TurboQ8.notes: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo with an 8-bit transformer instead of the 4-bit one. Measured on its own, the 8-bit transformer is closer to full precision (the GGUF card's LPIPS against BF16: 0.037, against 0.147 for the 4-bit one), but both Turbo entries use the same 4-bit text encoder, which the card measured moving pictures about as far as the 4-bit transformer does. It shares the text encoder, VAE and vision files with Qwen-Image 2.1, so they download once. Only the plug-ins validated on it apply, never a speed plug-in. Needs 32 GB of system memory (RAM).
catalog.license.qwenImage: Qwen Research License (non-commercial); text encoder Apache-2.0
catalog.model.minimaxH3.parameters: 33B audio-video DiT (20B with its AdaLN branches pruned) + Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder
catalog.model.minimaxH3Fl2va.notes: Makes a short video with its own soundtrack from a description, brings an attached photo to life, or runs between two photos (the first and the last frame). Needs 32 GB of system memory (RAM). MiniMax's license does not cover use in the EU, the UK, South Korea or the US.
catalog.model.minimaxH3Ref2va.notes: Makes a short video with its own soundtrack that features the people, things, places or sounds in up to nine attached photos, clips and recordings. Say who or what is in the shot: a reference gives their look, the description puts them in the scene. Needs 32 GB of system memory (RAM). MiniMax's license does not cover use in the EU, the UK, South Korea or the US.
catalog.lora.viggleTurbo.purpose: Pictures and edits in 6 steps instead of 40, close to the full model's quality.
catalog.lora.pruna8Step.purpose: Pictures and edits in 8 steps instead of 40.
catalog.lora.pruna5Step.purpose: Pictures and edits in 5 steps: the fastest, with visibly lower quality than 8-step.
catalog.lora.funAcc4Step.purpose: Pictures and edits in 4 steps. Small text and some edits come out weaker than the full model's.
catalog.lora.filmStills.purpose: The look of a cinematic 35mm film still.
catalog.lora.grainscape.purpose: A grainy, high-ISO 35mm colour-negative film look.
catalog.lora.qualityFix.purpose: A DoRA its author made to correct the model's common flaws. It was tuned for a different sampler than the app's, so judge it on your own pictures.
catalog.license.noneStated: No license stated by the author
catalog.lora.detailEnhancer.purpose: Finer detail and cleaner textures for an attached picture, keeping its composition.
catalog.lora.naturalExposure.purpose: Corrects an attached photo's exposure to a balanced, neutral one.
catalog.lora.objectRemover.purpose: Removes what is inside red boxes drawn on an attached photo and fills in the background. It does not manage every photo, so check the result.
catalog.lora.objectMover.purpose: Moves the object in one red box drawn on an attached photo to the spot marked by a second red box.
catalog.lora.animeConsistency.purpose: Keeps an anime character the same when an attached picture is edited into a new pose, view or expression. Experimental.
catalog.extended.gemmaLarge.notes: Vision and the matching MTP draft head are optional downloads. Gemma DSpark/DFlash drafts are not supported. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.qwen35Large.notes: Hybrid mixture of experts with an optional vision projector. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.qwen36Large.notes: Vision is optional. The embedded NextN head needs no extra download; the app defaults to n-gram speculative decoding. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.gptOss.notes: Text-only mixture of experts with reasoning always enabled. TensorSharp does not support its published EAGLE3 draft. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.nemotron.notes: Text-only hybrid SSM/Transformer. TensorSharp refuses speculative decoding for this family because verification and decode kernels disagree. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.nemotronOmni.notes: The optional projector enables images. Audio needs a separately converted Parakeet companion and is not included. Speculative decoding is unsupported. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.mistral.notes: Optional Pixtral vision projector. This implementation supports chat and images without thinking or tool calls. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.hunyuan.notes: Tencent translation model using hunyuan-dense. Text only, one device, without thinking or tool calls. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.deepseek4.notes: All three shards are required. The optional matching 0731 DSpark draft runs on CUDA with greedy sampling. Requires workstation memory. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.deepseek41.notes: Repaired ten-shard release with embedded Engram. CUDA is the serving backend; CPU is for portability. Vision and DSpark need TensorSharp conversion tools; published clip/dflash companions are incompatible. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.glm.notes: Text only; every shard is required. NextN is embedded, with no separate draft download. GLM 5.3 NextN requires one device or layer splitting; the app defaults to n-gram speculation. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.glmFlash.notes: Every shard is required. Optional GLM-OCR vision projector. Its separate NextN/MTP block is not supported. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.diffusionGemma.notes: Generates text by diffusion. An optional upstream safetensors shard supplies vision. Audio, video and tool calls are unsupported. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.wanText.notes: Text-to-video without audio. Includes the required UMT5 text encoder and matching Wan 2.1 VAE. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.wanBase.notes: Base text/image-to-video model without audio. Its full schedule is much slower than Turbo. Includes the matching Wan 2.2 VAE and UMT5 encoder. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.wanTurbo.notes: Four-step text/image-to-video model without audio. Includes the matching Wan 2.2 VAE and UMT5 encoder. Keep the Turbo file name so the engine selects its distilled schedule. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.wanA14Text.notes: Text-to-video without audio. Requires both high- and low-noise denoisers, the Wan 2.1 VAE and UMT5 encoder; all are included. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
catalog.extended.wanA14Image.notes: Requires a first-frame image. Both high- and low-noise denoisers, the Wan 2.1 VAE and UMT5 encoder are included and required. Generates video without audio. Catalog metadata is verified; TensorAgent inference is not yet validated.
